verdict.rationale: Bulk operations such as multi-select triage are a fair axis for a mobile client, but the GitHub Mobile evidence only describes single-item actions: reviewing and merging PRs, triaging, and starting or tracking individual agent tasks. Nothing shows multi-select or batch actions. The REST/GraphQL APIs, GitHub CLI, Actions and Copilot automations are separate platform features or developer building blocks, not capabilities of the mobile app, so they earn no credit.
